mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with unemployment below 4.0% and job growth exceeding 0.5% monthly, the S&P 500 underperforms due to anticipated policy tightening, producing negative returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units for two consecutive months, it indicates housing market contraction that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) combined with high policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals aggressive policy that depresses equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and job growth (PAYEMS) indicate labor market slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both UNRATE and PAYEMS decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02.
